note_en: 一…就… links two events that follow each other immediately, like English "as soon as… (then)…": 一到晚上，摊贩的灯就一个接一个地亮起来 "As soon as evening falls, the vendors' lights come on one after another." 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 right before the second, and the subject can sit in front of either half.
